prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions are often higher than noise-corrected results, though several smaller predictions underestimated actual gains.
No clear effect was seen for home, wait_info changes across four tests.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path, hint changes across two tests.
Evidence for sign_in, reorder changes remains thin because results contradict each other across three tests.
Evidence for sign_in, copy changes is still thin because one test won while the other showed no clear effect.
Evidence for adoption, finish, choose_path layout, and home notification changes remains thin with only one test per specific change type.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Redesign photo upload with live avatar preview stage: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a stage layout featuring a live rendered preview component so users verify avatar output before finalizing. (why: Adoption has high median time (89s) and 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failures or incorrect pet appearance.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after waiting screen: Move the sign-in screen after the desktop waiting screen so authentication occurs right before final launch. (why: Sign-in drop-off remains high (23.1% loss) and moving account creation after the pet engine finishes initializing ensures setup completes seamlessly.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop placement verification interactive flow: Introduce a desktop visibility verification step during waiting with an interactive button to confirm pet overlay rendering. (why: 3 support tickets noted pet overlay missing from desktop or app failing to display after onboarding completion.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Existing pet recovery sign-in notice: Add reassuring copy explaining that signing into an existing account immediately restores saved pets and custom settings. (why: The single largest support theme (8 emails) reported missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Story screen companion teaser hint: Display a hint on the story screen describing how desktop pets interact directly with desktop windows and system tray. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users with a high mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion about pet behavior.)
5: [home, wait_info] Background desktop engine setup progress details: Provide detailed status text on the waiting screen explaining background window anchoring and engine initialization. (why: Home waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s and 3 users reported desktop launch issues.)
6: [home, notification] Audio cue on pet initialization ready: Play a subtle audio notification chime when the pet engine finishes loading on the waiting screen. (why: High waiting mean duration (2336s) indicates users switch tasks or step away while the app initializes.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Grid layout for story introduction: Switch the story screen layout to a structured grid to present key desktop pet features upfront. (why: Choosing a path takes a mean of 514s with 76.2% conversion; a structured layout speeds up feature understanding.)
